deals.evidence: wurde die Kapitalerhöhung in Höhe von 24,68 Mio. Euro vom Amtsgericht Charlottenburg nun eingetragen
deals.headline: Union's stadium company raises €24.68m in a share issue to members and fans
deals.investor: 1. FC Union Berlin e.V. (40,000 new shares) and over 6,800 existing and new fan/member shareholders
deals.source_name: An der Alten Försterei Stadionbetriebs AG
deals.summary: 'An der Alten Försterei' Stadionbetriebs AG raised €24.68m of new equity (share capital now €30.9m) to fund the stadium expansion and refinance debt; the e.V. subscribed 40,000 shares and now holds 75.75%, the free float of over 10,000 shareholders 24.25%.

deals.evidence: Von diesem Recht hat die AG Gebrauch gemacht und das Stadion im Kalenderjahr 2023 für einen Betrag in Höhe von EUR 2.760.000,00 erworben.
deals.headline: Union's stadium company buys the Alte Försterei out of its Berlin leasehold for €2.76m
deals.investor: An der Alten Försterei Stadionbetriebs AG
deals.summary: The stadium company exercised the purchase right in its 2008 hereditary building lease (running to 2073) and bought the stadium in 2023 for €2.76m.

stadium_owner.detail: Owned by 'An der Alten Försterei' Stadionbetriebs AG, which held a leasehold from Berlin to 2073 and bought the stadium outright in 2023 for €2.76m; after the 2024/25 capital increase 1. FC Union Berlin e.V. holds 75.75% and a free float of over 10,000 members, fans and sponsors 24.25%. The club rents it from the AG. Expansion to 34,500 is planned, with the team moving temporarily to the Olympiastadion.
stadium_owner.evidence: Von diesem Recht hat die AG Gebrauch gemacht und das Stadion im Kalenderjahr 2023 für einen Betrag in Höhe von EUR 2.760.000,00 erworben.

founded_evidence: nach der Gründung des 1. FC Union Berlin im Januar 1966
name: 1. FC Union Berlin e.V.
notes: Revenue 2025/26 (€197.6m, surplus €411k, equity €8.5m, liabilities €119m) is from Tagesspiegel's report of the 3 September 2026 members' meeting; the club's own site still carries only the 2024/25 figures (Einnahmen €191.66m, profit €0.45m, equity €8.07m; members' meeting 19 May 2026). No pre-tax result, wages, breakdown, net debt, attendance, valuation or dated social counts found. Stadium expansion: €190m next phase including club house and car park, €61m from own funds (Tagesspiegel); capacity at reopening 34,500. The 2011 fan share issue (€2.723m) predates 2015 and is not listed as a deal. Press reports a €2.5m KfW loan to the stadium AG in 2020 and DKB/Land Berlin funding of the 2012-13 main stand, but those pages (kicker) could not be opened.

owners.name: Members of 1. FC Union Berlin e.V.

ownership_summary: 1. FC Union Berlin e.V. is a registered members' association that runs the professional teams itself and reports consolidated accounts for the e.V. and its subsidiaries; it had 71,958 members on 30 September 2026. Its stadium company is 75.75% owned by the e.V. and 24.25% by fans and sponsors; there is no outside investor in the club.
revenue_evidence: In der Saison 2025/26 hat Union insgesamt 197,6 Millionen Euro eingenommen und einen Überschuss von 411.000 Euro erwirtschaftet.
revenue_source_name: Der Tagesspiegel, reporting the club's 2025/26 figures from the members' meeting of 3 September 2026
